DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE
PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)
OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES (REVISED)
1. OBJECTIVES AND SCHEME OVERVIEW
1.1 The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding from Governmen
1.2 Under the Scheme, financial benefit of ₹6,000/- per year is provided to all eligible landholding farmer families across the
1.3 The financial benefit shall be credited directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of the beneficiary farmers through
1.4 Effective Date: The Scheme came into effect on 1st December 2018 (01-12-2018).
2. DEFINITION OF BENEFICIARY FAMILY
A landholding farmer family is defined as a family comprising of husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land a

3. EXCLUSION CRITERIA (MANDATORY INELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS)
The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall NOT be eligible for benefit under the scheme:
(a) All Institutional Landholders.
(b) Farmer families in which one or more of its members belong to subsequent categories:
(i) Former and present holders of constitutional posts.
(ii) Former and present Ministers/State Ministers and former/present Members of Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha/State Legislativ
(iii) All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries/Offices/Departments and their fie
(iv) All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is ₹10,000/- or more (Excluding MTS / Class IV / Group
(v) All persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.
(vi) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional b
4. MANDATORY VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
4.1 Aadhaar authentication is mandatory for all beneficiaries.
4.2 Landholding verification through state land records (B-1/Khasra) is compulsory.
4.3 e-KYC through PM-KISAN portal or biometric CSC centers is required.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Operational Guidelines
text:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE
PRADHAN MANTRI FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY)
1. SCHEME COVERAGE AND OBJECTIVES
1.1 PMFBY provides comprehensive insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harv
1.2 The scheme covers food crops (Cereals, Millets, and Pulses), Oilseeds, and Annual Commercial / Horticultural crops.
2. PREMIUM RATES PAYABLE BY FARMERS
2.1 Kharif Season: Maximum 2.0% of Sum Insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less, for food and oilseeds crops.
2.2 Rabi Season: Maximum 1.5% of Sum Insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less, for food and oilseeds crops.
2.3 Commercial / Horticultural Crops: Maximum 5.0% of Sum Insured for both Kharif and Rabi seasons.
2.4 The balance premium is shared equally (50:50) by Central Government and State Government as subsidy.

document_title: Chhattisgarh Krishak Unnati Yojana Notification and Operational Guidelines
text:
GOVERNMENT OF CHHATTISGARH
DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE DEVELOPMENT AND FARMER WELFARE
MANTRALAYA, MAHANADI BHAWAN, NAWA RAIPUR
CHHATTISGARH KRISHAK UNNATI YOJANA NOTIFICATION (2024)
1. YOJANA PURPOSE AND SCOPE
1.1 To promote crop diversification, increase farmer income, and provide fair price for agricultural produce in Chhattisgarh.
1.2 Input assistance of differential amount is provided to paddy farmers to ensure aggregate realization of ₹3,100 per quintal
1.3 Up to 21 quintals per acre of paddy shall be procured and supported under this scheme.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
(a) The farmer must be a bonafide resident of the State of Chhattisgarh.
(b) Farmer must be registered on the Unified Kisan Panjiyan Portal (Kisan Portal Chhattisgarh).
(c) Must hold valid landholding records verified through B-1 P-II Khasra documents.
(d) Benefit shall NOT be provided to unregistered farmers or unverified land entries.
(e) Direct Benefit Transfer shall be credited directly to the Aadhaar-linked active bank account.
